meta.title: DSH Connect Qoder
meta.description: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.

en.account.confirmExpired: Confirmed: sign-in expired — sign in again in the Qoder client, then re-read
en.account.confirmNoSignIn: There is no sign-in to confirm for this edition — sign in first, or set an environment PAT (QODERCN_PAT / QODER_PAT)
en.account.confirmProtocolChanged: Confirmation hit an unrecognised API shape — update the plugin (signing in again will not help)
en.account.deviceActive: You are signed in with the plugin's own sign-in (browser sign-in) — the desktop client is not needed.
en.account.download: The Qoder client is missing — install {edition} from the Download section, then sign in
en.account.error: Could not read the account states
en.account.expiredHint: Sign-in has lapsed — sign in again in the Qoder client ({app}), then click Re-read sign-in
en.account.offerError: Could not save the edition switch: {detail}
en.account.offerOff: Disabled: this edition's models are not offered to the model picker
en.account.offerTitle: Turning this off hides the edition's models from DSH's model picker; the sign-in, usage and model settings are kept, and turning it back on restores them.
en.account.readFail: Could not read the local credential: {detail}. Either set an environment PAT (QODERCN_PAT / QODER_PAT), or press Re-read sign-in
en.account.readFailDevice: Could not read the local credential: {detail}. Either press Sign in with a browser (the plugin's own sign-in, which works without the desktop client), or set an environment PAT (QODERCN_PAT / QODER_PAT), or press Re-read sign-in
en.account.regionTabs: Editions: pick which one's account, usage and models to view
en.account.unsigned: No Qoder client for this edition is installed on this machine
en.device.available: Works without the desktop client: approve a code in your browser and the plugin stores the refreshable token it gets back, in this edition's own file only.
en.device.loginExpired: The authorization timed out — press Sign in with a browser to start again
en.device.loginLost: That sign-in attempt is no longer pending — start it again
en.device.renewFailed: The plugin sign-in could not be renewed: {reason} — press Sign in with a browser to authorize again
en.device.saveFailed: The plugin sign-in renewed successfully but could not be written to disk: {reason} — this session keeps working, a restart will not; check that the plugin directory is writable
en.device.signOutFailed: Could not sign out of the plugin: {detail}
en.device.signOutNote: Only the plugin's own token is deleted; the desktop client's sign-in, an environment PAT, and the other edition's file are all untouched.
en.device.startFailed: Could not open the authorization page: {detail}
en.device.state.expired: The plugin sign-in has expired — press Sign in with a browser to authorize again
en.device.state.none: This machine has no plugin sign-in
en.device.state.unknown: The plugin sign-in is in a state this card does not know (the host is newer)
en.device.title: Plugin sign-in
en.device.unreadable: The plugin's saved sign-in file cannot be read: {reason}
en.device.waiting: Authorization page opened — waiting for approval (up to 5 minutes)
en.row.desc: Use the Qoder models already signed in on this machine (Qoder CN / Qoder); image input is decided per model.
en.row.imageHint: "Follow catalog" uses Qoder's own vision flag; On/Off forces it. An enabled model accepts images.
en.row.imageTuningTitle: Off by default: every model follows the vision flag Qoder's own catalog declares. Turn it on to force image input on or off per model; a model you have already changed stays visible either way.
en.row.maxWindow: Show each model's maximum context window
en.row.maxWindowNote: No switchable context window offered for this model
en.row.maxWindowTitle: On: show the widest window the model offers. Off: show the default window. Models with no listed window cannot be switched.
en.row.offPeakHint: The off-peak discount applies {window} ({zone}); the rate shown follows the current window and changes on its own at the boundary.
en.row.protocolChanged: Qoder replied in a format this plugin does not recognise — update the plugin (signing in again will not help)
en.row.providerRegistrationFailed: The model provider failed to register when the plugin started ({reason}): the models below cannot be picked in chat. The full error is in the host log.
en.row.refreshDailyLimit: Upstream says today's allowance is spent — it resets at midnight (this is not a sign-in problem, and updating will not help)
en.row.refreshNotPersisted: Refreshed, but the catalog could not be written — it will revert after a restart (the next refresh retries automatically)
en.row.regionEmpty: No models to show for this edition right now (not signed in, or its switch is off).
en.row.requestFailed: Could not read the model catalog
en.row.showHint: An unchecked model is hidden from DSH's model picker.
en.row.signedOut: No signed-in Qoder app was found, so there are no models.
en.row.title: Connect Qoder credits and models (dsh-connect-qoder)
en.usage.dailyLimit: Today's allowance is spent (upstream's own words) — it comes back after the midnight reset
en.usage.empty: This account has no usage to show right now.
en.usage.none: No usage data for this edition (not signed in, or offline yet).
en.usage.promotionsProtocolChanged: The offers endpoint replied in a shape this plugin does not recognise — update the plugin (signing in again will not help)
en.usage.protocolChanged: Qoder replied in a shape this plugin does not recognise — update the plugin (signing in again will not help)
en.usage.requestsExhausted: Daily allowance may be used up (local estimate, for reference)
en.usage.requestsToday: Requested {count} times via this client today
en.usage.requestsUnavailable: Local request count not wired in
en.usage.title: My usage
en.usage.unavailable: Usage is unavailable for this region right now.
